request: We're a 4-clinic dental group with a Facebook Page and Instagram. Write our social media policy: employee guidelines, community guidelines, who approves what, how fast we reply, and what our moderators hide. Base the moderation rules on our real comments.

brief.what_it_sells: general, cosmetic and children's dentistry, implants and whitening
brief.location: Portland, Oregon area, United States (4 clinics: Eastside, Westgate, Riverside, Northgate)

team.moderates: Marketing coordinator, with the front desk lead as backup

brief.watched_hours: Monday to Friday 8:00 to 18:00 and Saturday 9:00 to 13:00, Pacific time
brief.sponsored_content: gifts whitening kits to 3 local creators a quarter; staff share clinic posts
brief.existing_documents: a brand voice guide; no social media policy; no crisis plan
